# ScaleForge

> ScaleForge is a premier digital agency building high-performance websites, custom AI automations, and growth-driven SEO & content strategies for ambitious teams.

## Core Navigation
* [Home](https://scalesforge.site/): High-level overview of our services, performance metrics, and client testimonials.
* [Services](https://scalesforge.site/services): Full catalog of our digital capability suites.
* [Solutions](https://scalesforge.site/solutions): Bespoke software packages and custom integrations for businesses.
* [Pricing](https://scalesforge.site/pricing): Transparent tiers for web design, web development, SEO, content creation, and AI automations.
* [Projects](https://scalesforge.site/projects): Selected case studies demonstrating user growth and workflow optimizations.
* [About](https://scalesforge.site/about): ScaleForge story, core team profiles, and operational standards.
* [Blog](https://scalesforge.site/blog): Strategic insights on development, automation, and search engine optimization.
* [Contact](https://scalesforge.site/contact): Consultation request form and scheduling calendars.

## Digital Services & Capabilities
* [AI Development & Automation](https://scalesforge.site/services/ai-development): n8n, Make.com, and Zapier workflows, custom AI cold-calling voice agents (Vapi), automated lead scraping pipelines, and social media posting autopilot configurations.
* [Web Design](https://scalesforge.site/services/web-design): Brand-driven responsive wireframing and high-fidelity layouts designed from scratch in Figma. Zero templates.
* [Web Development](https://scalesforge.site/services/web-development): Fast React & Next.js client-facing websites, edge-cached hosting, clean Tailwind styling, and headless CMS integrations (Sanity).
* [SEO (Search Engine Optimization)](https://scalesforge.site/services/seo): Full technical crawls, page load speed improvements, custom schema markup, on-page optimization, and organic traffic growth.
* [Content Creation](https://scalesforge.site/services/content-creation): High-authority SEO blogs, engaging email newsletters, marketing copy, and multi-channel content pipelines.
* [Startup Advisory](https://scalesforge.site/services/startup-advisory): Technical validation, MVP scope definition, and investor-ready pitch decks for founders.
* [Social Media Branding](https://scalesforge.site/services/social-media-branding): Design systems, templates, and asset creation for digital profiles.
* [Supply Chain Software](https://scalesforge.site/services/supply-chain-management): Custom sales forecasting pipelines, inventory systems, and ERP integrations.
* [Motion Analysis](https://scalesforge.site/services/motion-analysis): Spacing, speed, and time-and-motion studies to optimize industrial/operational workflows.
